name: VRM_SOURCE_DOC_SUB_LINES
description: This object stores document data from the upstream applications, which is at a sub level to either document header or document line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUB_LINE_ID
columns.description: System-generated unique key for source document sub line. Examples of source document sub line include invoice line salescredits, contingencies, and project accounting distributions.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: System-generated unique key for source document line. Examples of source document line include sales order line, invoice line, project line, and service contract line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Source document identifier of line. Foreign key to DOCUMENT_ID in VRM_SOURCE_DOCUMENTS.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Oracle Application identifier of source document. Foreign key to FND applications table. For example, 222 for Receivables invoices, or users can optionally use -1.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID

columns.name: DOC_SUB_LINE_TYPE

columns.name: DOC_SUB_LINE_LEVEL

columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: SALESREP_NAME
columns.description: Salesperson name on source document sub line. This column is used for information only within MEA. For revenue assignments to salespersons, specify the information in SP_FIRST_NAME, SP_LAST_NAME and SP_MIDDLE_NAME columns.

columns.name: REVENUE_AMOUNT_SPLIT
columns.description: Revenue split amount of source document sub line. This column is valid for sub line type SALESCREDITS and when REVENUE_PERCENT_SPLIT is not used.

columns.name: REVENUE_PERCENT_SPLIT
columns.description: Revenue split percent of source document sub line. This column is valid for sub line type SALESCREDITS and when REVENUE_AMOUNT_SPLIT is not used.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_CODE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_NAME
columns.description: Revenue contingency name on source document sub line. This column is valid for sub line type CONTINGENCIES.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_ID
columns.description: Revenue contingency identifier on source document sub line. This column is valid for sub line type CONTINGENCIES.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which revenue contingency expires on source document sub line. This column is valid for sub line type CONTINGENCIES.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days until contingency expiration for source document sub line. This column is valid for sub line type CONTINGENCIES.

columns.name: EXPIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the contingency has expired on source document sub line. Possible values are Y and N. This column is valid for sub line type CONTINGENCIES.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_EVENT_DATE
columns.description: Date on which contingency automatically or manually expires on source document sub line. This column is valid for sub line type CONTINGENCIES.

columns.name: EXPIRED_BY
columns.description: User who expired the contingency for source document sub line. This column is valid for sub line type CONTINGENCIES.

columns.description: Satisfaction measurement date.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_EVENT_QUANTITY
columns.description: Used to derive the quantity of a satisfaction event when the satisfaction measurement model is Measure Quantity Satisfied.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_EVENT_PERCENT
columns.description: Used to derive the percent of a satisfaction event when the satisfaction measurement model is Measure Percentage Satisfied.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the source document type.

columns.name: PERIOD_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action type for period satisfaction events. This attribute is required if the subline type is Period. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_PERIOD_SUBLINE_ACTION. Reverse indicates that Revenue Management will not recognize revenue from the period satisfaction event effective date to the plan end date.  Revenue, if recognized will be reversed during this period.  Reinstate indicates that Revenue Management will start recognizing revenue from the period satisfaction event effective date to the effective plan end date.  The effective plan end date is calculated as the actual plan end date plus the number of days that revenue was recognized.

columns.name: PERIOD_ACTION_EVENT_DATE
columns.description: Effective date for the period satisfaction event action.

columns.name: PREV_DOCUMENT_SUB_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document subline identifier of the earlier period type subline. When a reinstated subline is received after a reversed subline, this attribute is populated on the reinstated subline.

columns.name: ASE_ENTERED_CUR_REVENUE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Fulfillment amount of the primary satisfaction event in the entered currency.

columns.name: ASE_CONT_CUR_ALLOC_REV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Allocated amount equivalent to the fulfillment amount of the primary satisfaction event in the contract currency.
